name: ray-plugins
description: Ray Data Co's example Claude Code plugin marketplace — a minimal working template you can copy.

plugins.name: rdco-example
plugins.description: Minimal example plugin: two example skills (rdco-greeting + rdco-hello), skills-only. Copy this folder as a template for your own plugin.

plugins.name: copilot-studio-agent-builder
plugins.description: Guides the full lifecycle of building a Microsoft Copilot Studio agent (plan -> build -> test -> publish -> maintain) and emits five standard deliverables. Standardizes on generative orchestration; bakes in verified Microsoft Learn corrections + safe defaults (Work IQ off, newest Sonnet, grounded internal agents).

plugins.name: snowflake-cli
plugins.description: Teaches Claude Code to use the Snowflake CLI (`snow`) — primarily to execute SQL and deploy DDL — via a /prime-snow-cli index skill plus reference files that mirror the full `snow` command tree (connection, object, stage, snowpark, streamlit, app, spcs, cortex, dbt, git, notebook, dcm) with pointers to the official docs.

plugins.name: ab-skill-factory
plugins.description: The factory brigade — the first agent brigade, and the one that manufactures skills and whole discipline brigades. A multi-agent assembly line (spec -> tests -> author -> critic, convergence loop) that forces depth in from a competency source and gates slop with independent critics. The expo is the general per-brigade station coordinator; ships the expo, the build stations, the standard mise + service surface, reference workflows, and the variance-analysis worked example. (Renamed from skill-agent-brigade.)

plugins.name: ab-registrar
plugins.description: The registrar — the house's first 'house role' (a coordinator/record-keeper install unit, not a kitchen brigade that cooks tickets). Ships mise + three role skills: steward (front-of-house intake, context curation, the needs-context rework loop, and the close-out sweep — moved here from the factory), registry (the menu catalog, scan-on-demand over published menus), and orders (open-orders report). No service/fire/stations — a house role never works a ticket.

plugins.name: ab-legal
plugins.description: Legal-review agent brigade (structural, not advisory): the standard mise + expo + service surface over eval-proven structural legal-review stations. Two live — regulatory-notice-coverage (GDPR Art.13/14 + CCPA/CPRA disclosure-element coverage, +0.60 lift) and contract-clause-coverage (standard expected clause set by contract type, +1.00 lift, base missed all 5) — plus one held-for-refire (redline-against-playbook). Every station checks a document against an explicit enumerated standard and reports coverage/gaps; it never gives legal advice or makes a lawfulness/compliance determination.

plugins.name: ab-managerial-accounting
plugins.description: Managerial-accounting agent brigade (né discipline-skills): the standard brigade surface — mise (readiness gate) + expo (composes the finance stations for a request, incl. compound asks like a full due-diligence picture) + service — over 5 eval-proven finance stations (variance-analysis, annual-budget-build, close-management, treasury-liquidity-analysis, debt-schedule) plus a base-model-covered registry. Every station ships with two-arm execution-eval evidence.

plugins.name: ab-data-engineering
plugins.description: Data-engineering agent brigade: the standard brigade surface (mise + expo + service) over eval-proven DE stations. First station: pipeline-failure-triage (+1.00 lift — classifies silent zero-row failures the base model misreads as transient infra). Menu carries honest status for the rest of the vertical (held-for-refire, weak-evidence, base-model-covered-pending).

plugins.name: ab-domain-research
plugins.description: Domain-research agent brigade — the FILL brigade that stocks a knowledge cellar with domain competency and gold exemplars for generative-skill builds. Standard brigade surface (mise incl. CELLAR_ROOT check + expo + service) over 5 eval-proven sourcing stations: cert-body-sourcing (+0.60), standards-regulatory-sourcing (+1.00), academic-ocw-sourcing (+0.60, CC-licensed-only gate), public-filings-exemplars (+0.40-0.60 — EDGAR/SAM.gov/courts/patents/GAO gold exemplars with why_gold), award-case-study-exemplars (+0.60 — creative-domain gold exemplars from juried award libraries, Effie/Cannes/D&AD/IPA). License gate before content, authority tiering, per-source dispositions, provenance on everything, injection-suspect discipline. Curation, never bulk scraping.

plugins.name: ab-marketing
plugins.description: Marketing agent brigade: the standard brigade surface (mise + expo + service) over eval-proven marketing stations. First live station: effectiveness-narrative-draft (+1.00 lift — drafts campaign-effectiveness narratives/measurement plans in the findings-evidence-recommendation discipline, graded against rubrics derived from real GAO campaign-evaluation gold; the marketplace's first exemplar-graded generative station). MENU carries honest held-for-refire rows with real evidence for the rest (positioning +1.00 and brief +0.80 held on named critic defects incl. a caught license violation; 3 structural FTC coverage stations held on eval precision). Only eval-passers ship.
